name: Mutinta
face: Eight-year-old Zambian girl with warm brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright smile.
clothing: One-shoulder chitenge of green, orange, and black triangles tied in a knot at the waist, and brown sandals. An orange and green geometric headwrap with two tails.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Orange and green geometric headwrap with two tails, short dark curls at the nape, and a one-shoulder chitenge of green, orange, and black triangles knotted at the waist.
